source: arXiv API (abstract search), citations from the Semantic Scholar batch API
focus_corpus: top decile of the deduplicated corpus by TF-IDF relevance to the project documents
clusters: k-means, k = 12, on an LSA projection of the focus corpus; labels written by hand from top terms and titles

queries.steering_core: abs:"activation steering" OR abs:"steering vector" OR abs:"steering vectors" OR abs:"activation addition" OR abs:"representation engineering" OR abs:"contrastive activation addition"
queries.steering_eval: (abs:steering AND abs:"language model") AND (abs:"side effects" OR abs:capability OR abs:benchmark OR abs:reliability OR abs:evaluation OR abs:robustness)
queries.sae_features: abs:"sparse autoencoder" OR abs:"sparse autoencoders" OR abs:"sparse dictionary"
queries.mech_interp_linear: abs:"linear representation hypothesis" OR abs:"residual stream" OR abs:"massive activations" OR abs:"attention sink" OR abs:"activation patching"
queries.multilingual_steering: (abs:multilingual OR abs:"cross-lingual" OR abs:"language-specific") AND (abs:steering OR abs:neurons OR abs:"language vector" OR abs:"language identity")
queries.cultural_religious_alignment: (abs:religion OR abs:religious OR abs:islamic OR abs:muslim OR abs:cultural OR abs:culture) AND abs:"language model" AND (abs:alignment OR abs:values OR abs:bias OR abs:norms)
queries.arabic_llm: abs:arabic AND (abs:"language model" OR abs:LLM OR abs:LLMs) AND (abs:alignment OR abs:culture OR abs:cultural OR abs:evaluation OR abs:benchmark)
queries.quran_islamic_nlp: abs:quran OR abs:quranic OR abs:hadith OR abs:"islamic knowledge" OR abs:"islamic jurisprudence" OR abs:fiqh
queries.agent_prompt_injection: (abs:"prompt injection" OR abs:"indirect prompt injection") AND (abs:agent OR abs:agents OR abs:tool)
queries.agent_policy_enforcement: (abs:agent OR abs:agents) AND (abs:LLM OR abs:"language model") AND (abs:"access control" OR abs:"policy enforcement" OR abs:"information flow" OR abs:privilege OR abs:sandbox OR abs:guardrail OR abs:"runtime monitor")
queries.attention_geometry: abs:attention AND (abs:curvature OR abs:holonomy OR abs:sheaf OR abs:"fiber bundle" OR abs:"gauge" OR abs:"parallel transport" OR abs:commutativity)
